caption: The drawing depicts two silver spoons horizontally aligned on a plain, off-white background. The top spoon is shown with its bowl on the left and handle to the right; the handle features a small rectangular marking with lettering, while the bowl has a shell-like decorative motif where it meets the handle. The bottom spoon is similarly oriented, but its bowl is visible from a slightly different angle, showing its concavity; the handle end features intricate floral embellishments and engraved script letters, as well as a small classical urn or vase. The drawing uses shades of gray and black for shading and detail, giving the spoons a metallic, reflective appearance. In the lower left corner of the paper, the artist's signature "WALTON" is visible. The background remains plain, with some faint discoloration or age marks along the edges.
title: Silver Spoon
